flags: Price gate: $45 full hookup in June 2027 on the booking map, under US$50 (Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP 30 km in any case). Family has not stayed here.

Long-stay character check: passes on what is visible - nightly rates posted and sold online per night, reviews are travellers' ('Would stay here again', 'Stayed there 2 weeks ago'). The posted weekly rates ($200-225) are low against $40-45 nightly and there are 3 park models, so some extended stays are likely; no monthly rate, seasonal sites or homes for sale are advertised.
Presence: working website with phone (970) 872-2351, own booking engine, Google Maps 4.1 / 88 reviews. Open now (year-round).
